title: Negative Business Balance Recovery — Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
The business balance of a Pocketwire Business Profile can go negative through refunds, chargebacks and fees.

When the balance has stayed negative for longer than the tier's negative-balance period in calendar days, counted from the first day it went negative, the shortfall is recovered in one step from the owner's Pocketwire Personal Account balance, as far as that balance allows, as an internal transfer. Any rest stays owed on the business balance. Sales received while the balance is negative reduce the shortfall first.

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| negative for no longer than the period | no recovery yet |
| negative for longer than the period, personal balance covers the shortfall | the whole shortfall is recovered and the business balance returns to zero |
| negative for longer than the period, personal balance smaller than the shortfall | the personal balance is recovered as far as it allows; the rest stays owed on the business balance |

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** A business balance of minus USD 120.00 that has stayed negative beyond the period, with USD 45.00 on the owner's personal balance: USD 45.00 is recovered and minus USD 75.00 stays owed on the business balance.
